method.deduplication: First isolate per subject per organism per period (CLSI M39). Kept 67 of 73 isolates between 2026-01-12 and 2026-09-01 (8.2% removed as repeats) across 55 subject(s). 7 of them (9.6%) carried no subject identifier and were kept as distinct, since repeat sampling cannot be detected without one.
